answer: Bind each agent identity to a quartz-hard cost: a hardware-attested key plus a slowly maturing stake that peers must vouch for over many epochs. A Sybil farm can spawn a plume of fresh keys, but each one starts with zero reputation, and attestations from its own cluster get discounted when graph analysis finds them forming an echo chamber of mutual vouching. Influence then scales with independent, aged endorsements rather than headcount.
